# Getting help

Start with the [README](../README.md), [verification guide](../docs/reference/verification.md), and [browser evidence](../docs/reference/browser-support.md). Viewer is a candidate reference client with deferred development, not a promise of support across Hub versions or browsers.

For a reproducible problem, prepare a short report for the repository maintainer with:

- Viewer source commit or package version, and whether local changes are present;
- fixture or live mode, browser and operating system;
- expected behaviour, actual behaviour, and the smallest reproduction;
- the relevant command and redacted error text;
- for live mode, the Hub version and public profile identity, without endpoint or pairing secrets.

Use synthetic data whenever possible. Check the [privacy guidance](../docs/legal/privacy.md) before sharing logs or screenshots. Do not post sensitive security details in a public report; follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

No response-time commitment or dedicated support service is documented for this project.
